notes: *together* is read as the English verb's phrasal particle rather than a separate unit, since no morpheme licenses it and the subtraction test leaves only the verb's rendering diminished (rule 44); the competing reading marks it added under rule 30.
`בְּשָׂרוֹ` → *his own flesh* gives the emphatic possessive whole to the suffix, headed on *his* (rule 18).
